subject.title: Bug: Web UI session context not preserved after restart — model can't see history that UI displays

question: For WebChat sessions restored from `chat.history`, should the first post-restart send use a one-shot resume exception, or should visible WebChat sessions always override configured idle/daily rollover?
rationale: The report is a real session-continuity bug, but current main and tests deliberately keep ordinary `sessionId` sends subject to freshness rollover, so the permanent WebChat session policy needs maintainer intent before the issue can close.

options.title: One-shot resume exception
options.body: Keep configured rollover behavior for ordinary sends and allow only the first verified post-reconnect or page-load continuation to reuse the displayed session.

options.title: Visible session overrides rollover
options.body: Treat any displayed WebChat session as authoritative and accept that WebChat can continue sessions past configured idle/daily freshness boundaries.

options.title: Explicit stale-session UX
options.body: Do not auto-continue stale visible sessions; add UI disclosure or a restore action when history is visible but rollover would create a new session.

recommendation.title: One-shot resume exception
recommendation.body: Keep configured rollover behavior for ordinary sends and allow only the first verified post-reconnect or page-load continuation to reuse the displayed session.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main work changed the exact WebChat/session freshness boundary and tests.
